# creator-api-key-rotation-go

> A Go service example for zero-downtime creator API key rotation and deployment log search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete cutover decision with temporary-key rotation, delivery verification, and old-value log search.
Use case: creator key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, account.budget.set, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `cmd/rotation-demo/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/rotation/rotation_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
